# NFL.com
> The official site of the National Football League for news, scores, schedules, standings, stats, video, and game coverage.

NFL.com is the league’s primary digital hub for live game information, team and player coverage, postseason races, video highlights, and streaming-related viewing options. It also provides official access points for schedules, standings, fantasy, draft, Combine, Pro Bowl Games, and Super Bowl coverage.

## Core Site
- [NFL.com Home](https://www.nfl.com/): Official NFL homepage with top stories, scores, schedules, standings, and featured video.
- [News](https://www.nfl.com/news/): League-wide news, analysis, transactions, injuries, and feature coverage.
- [Videos](https://www.nfl.com/videos/): Central video hub for highlights, interviews, recaps, and original content.
- [Photos](https://www.nfl.com/photos/): Official NFL photo galleries from games, events, and league moments.
- [Podcasts](https://www.nfl.com/podcasts/): NFL podcasts covering news, analysis, fantasy, and team storylines.

## Scores, Schedules & Standings
- [Scores](https://www.nfl.com/scores/): Official live scoreboard with game status, results, and matchup details.
- [Schedule](https://www.nfl.com/schedules/): Full NFL schedule with weekly matchups and season calendar.
- [Team Schedules](https://www.nfl.com/schedules/2025/by-team): Team-by-team schedule view for the current NFL season.
- [Standings](https://www.nfl.com/standings/): Division and conference standings with records and tiebreak context.
- [Playoff Picture](https://www.nfl.com/standings/playoff-picture): Current AFC and NFC postseason race and seeding outlook.
- [Playoff Bracket](https://www.nfl.com/playoffs/bracket/): Official playoff bracket showing postseason matchups and advancement.
- [NFL Network Games](https://www.nfl.com/network/games/): Schedule and information for games carried on NFL Network.

## Teams, Players & Stats
- [Teams](https://www.nfl.com/teams/): Directory of all 32 NFL teams with links to club pages.
- [Players](https://www.nfl.com/players/): Player profiles, bios, and related news and video.
- [Stats](https://www.nfl.com/stats/): League statistical leaders and sortable offensive, defensive, and special teams data.
- [Player Stats](https://www.nfl.com/stats/player-stats/): Individual player statistical leaders across major categories.
- [Team Stats](https://www.nfl.com/stats/team-stats/): Team performance rankings for offense, defense, and situational metrics.
- [Next Gen Stats](https://www.nfl.com/news/next-gen-stats): Data-driven analysis and advanced metrics powered by player tracking.

## Video & Highlights
- [Video Home](https://www.nfl.com/videos/): Main destination for NFL video clips, shows, and game coverage.
- [Game Highlights](https://www.nfl.com/videos/channel/game-highlights-vc/): Official game highlight packages and condensed key plays.
- [NFL Channel Live](https://www.nfl.com/watch/nfl-channel-live): Free always-on NFL Channel stream with curated football programming.
- [Game Replays](https://www.nfl.com/plus/replays/): Replay access for full games and condensed game viewing through NFL+.
- [Ways to Watch](https://www.nfl.com/ways-to-watch): Viewing guide for live games, broadcasts, and streaming options.
- [Ways to Watch by Week](https://www.nfl.com/ways-to-watch/by-week/): Weekly viewing schedule with broadcast and streaming availability.

## NFL+, Network & Streaming
- [NFL+](https://www.nfl.com/plus/): Subscription hub for live local and primetime games, replays, and premium features.
- [NFL+ Features](https://www.nfl.com/plus/learn-more): Overview of NFL+ plans, benefits, and supported viewing options.
- [NFL Network](https://www.nfl.com/network): NFL Network home for shows, live coverage, and programming information.
- [NFL Channel Live](https://www.nfl.com/watch/nfl-channel-live): Continuous free stream featuring NFL content, highlights, and replays.
- [Game Pass International](https://www.nflgamepass.com/en/?icampaign=gpi-nav-Game_Pass&utm_source=NFL&utm_medium=Navigation&utm_campaign=Nav_Bar_Game_Pass&utm_content=GLOBAL): International streaming destination for live games and on-demand NFL content.
- [DAZN NFL Game Pass](https://www.dazn.com/nfl): DAZN landing page for NFL Game Pass in supported markets.

## Events & League Calendar
- [Super Bowl](https://www.nfl.com/super-bowl/): Official Super Bowl coverage with news, events, and game information.
- [Pro Bowl Games](https://www.nfl.com/pro-bowl-games/): Pro Bowl Games schedules, rosters, news, and event coverage.
- [NFL Draft](https://www.nfl.com/draft/): Draft order, prospect coverage, picks, and event news.
- [Combine](https://www.nfl.com/combine/): NFL Scouting Combine coverage, workouts, results, and prospect analysis.
- [Free Agency](https://www.nfl.com/free-agency/): Official free agency news, signings, and offseason movement coverage.
- [International Games](https://www.nfl.com/international/): NFL international initiatives, games, and global fan information.

## Fantasy & Gaming
- [Fantasy Football](https://www.nfl.com/fantasy-football/): Official fantasy football hub with analysis, rankings, and tools.
- [Fantasy News](https://www.nfl.com/fantasy-football/news/): Fantasy-focused player updates, waiver advice, and weekly outlooks.
- [NFL Pick'em](https://www.nfl.com/predict/pickem): Weekly pick'em game for selecting NFL winners.
- [Playoff Challenge](https://www.nfl.com/playoffs/predict/pickem): Postseason prediction game and playoff fan engagement experience.

## Tickets, Travel & Experiences
- [Tickets](https://www.ticketmaster.com/nfl?wt.mc_id=NFL_LEAGUE_TICKETS_LINK&utm_source=NFL.com&utm_medium=client&utm_campaign=NFL_LEAGUE&utm_content=TICKETS_LINK): Official ticketing partner page for NFL game tickets.
- [VIP Experiences](https://onlocationexp.com/nfl?utm_source=nfl.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=nfl-main_menu_games_dropdown): Premium hospitality and event experiences for NFL games and events.
- [Ways to Watch](https://www.nfl.com/ways-to-watch): Official guide to watching NFL games across TV and streaming platforms.
